about: The library's search words (server/parts.mjs): aliases per part (English, Bangla, common words), word synonyms, and places = the things that usually go together. A new delivery adds its parts here; a miss in scripts/parts-test.mjs is fixed here, never in a prompt. phrases = [pattern, meaning] pairs read before the words ("lifts his head" means look up, not lift a box); patterns are case-insensitive regular expressions.

sit_take_paper_a: passes a paper across a table
sit_take_paper_b: takes the paper across a table
sit_pick_up_paper: picks a paper up from the table
sit_tick_with_pen: marks a paper with a pen

phrases: \b(press|presses|pressing) (their|his|her) lips (together )?to keep from laughing\b|\bto keep from laughing\b
